column3: Non-storable content is expected for dynamic Next.js pages and 404 probes in the baseline crawl.
Next.js production pages currently require script-src unsafe-inline for framework hydration scripts until nonce-based CSP is implemented.
Base64 disclosure is noisy for bundled Next.js assets and CSS data values; secret scanning covers real credential leakage.
Authentication form detection is informational and expected on the login page.
Auth forms are client-handled Supabase flows and do not submit state-changing POSTs to the Next.js server.
Sec-Fetch-* request headers are browser/client supplied and are not controllable response headers.
